```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
if(dir.exists(here::here("outputs", "diet_data_files"))==FALSE) dir.create(here::here("outputs", "diet_data_files"))
devtools::load_all()
library("parallel")
library("doSNOW")
```

Organize separate data files

organize data from Baker
```{r organize_baker, include=FALSE}
atlantis_fg_file <- "atlantis_fg.csv"

atlantis_groups_file <- "atlantis_groups_diet_data.csv"
data.file <- "baker_uw_2018-2014.csv"
source.name  <- "Baker_uw"
csv.file <- "diet_data_bakeruw.csv"
output.path <- here::here("outputs", "diet_data_files")


organize_baker(
  atlantis_fg_file, 
  atlantis_groups_file, 
  data.file, 
  source.name, 
  csv.file, 
  output.path)

```

Aggregate diet database

```{r aggregate_diet, include=FALSE}

func.groups <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data","func_group_update.csv"))
un.codes <- c("DC","DL","DR","BB","PB","PL","PS","MA","SG","CI","CO","CU","CI1_CI2","CH","ROCKFISH","BIRD")
orca.chinook <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data","orca_chinook_diet_prop.csv"))
fish.groups <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data","atlantis_fish_groups.csv"))
atlantis.diet.groups <- readxl::read_excel(here::here("data","Diet_database_V1_no_figures.xlsx"),sheet="Atlantis_groups")
invert.groups <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data","atlantis_invert_groups.csv"))
agg.groups <- c("CI","CO","CU","CI1_CI2","CH","ROCKFISH","BIRD")
herr.groups <- c("HEP","HEC")
chinook.sal <- c("CHY","CHS","CSY","CSS","CSN","CDS","CNY","CNS","CHC","CYE","CKS","SAF")
chin.coho.sal <- c("CHY","CHS","CSY","CSS","CSN","CDS","CNY","CNS","CHC","CYE","CKS","SAF","COH","COS","COD","COY")
chum.sal <- c("CMS", "CMF", "CMH")
coho.sal <- c("COH", "COS", "COD", "COY")
sal.groups <- c("CHY","CHS","CSY","CSS","CSN","CDS","CNY","CNS","CHC","CYE","CKS","COH","COS","COD","COY","CMS","CMF","CMH","PIS","SAL","SAF")
groups.notinmodel <- c("SEAL","MYCTOPHID","LAMPREY","FRESHWATER","CLADOCERA","PLANT","PARASITE","WHALE","MAMMAL","PELAGIC","STEELHEAD","SHARK")
hatchery.sal <- c("CHY","CHS","COH","CMS")
rockfish.list <- c("ROC","MRO","DVR","MVR")
bird.groups <- c("SB","SP")
invert.codes <- c("ZS","ZM","ZL","ZG","AUR","SQX","BMD","BD","BG","BMS","BML","PWN","BFF","BIV","BC","DUN","GEC")
bacterial.groups <- c("BB","PB")
#primary producers and codes that were unassigned
detritus.groups<- c("DC","DL","DR")

  aggregate_diets(func.groups,
  un.codes,
  orca.chinook,
  fish.groups,
  atlantis.diet.groups,
  invert.groups,
  agg.groups,
  herr.groups,
  chinook.sal,
  chin.coho.sal,
  chum.sal,
  coho.sal,
  sal.groups,
  groups.notinmodel,
  hatchery.sal,
  rockfish.list,
  bird.groups,
  invert.codes,
  bacterial.groups,
  detritus.groups)
  

```

```{r}
invert.data$prey <- factor(invert.data$prey, levels = prey.order)

  group_by(Predator, prey) %>%
  summarise(mean_prop = mean(proportion)) %>%

  geom_bar(stat="identity")+
  coord_flip()+
  scale_fill_manual(values=fill)+
  labs(x = "Predator",y="Proportion")+
```

Run dirichelet code on diet data

```{r dirichelet, echo=FALSE}
  #run multiple Atlantis simulations on local machine cores
 
 stage.list <- c("adult","juvenile","invert")
 parallel::detectCores() 
 NumberOfCluster <- length(stage.list) 
 
 # Initiate cluster
 cl <- parallel::makeCluster(NumberOfCluster)
 doSNOW::registerDoSNOW(cl)
 
 # Run this for loop for one call of model from each cluster, assuming cluster is already initiated. 
 atlantis.scenarios <- foreach(thispredstage=stage.list, .export = "do_dirichelet", .verbose = TRUE) %dopar% {
   
   local({r <- getOption("repos")
   r["CRAN"] <- "https://cloud.r-project.org" 
   options(repos=r)
   })
   
   # List of packages for session
   .packages = c("stringi","data.table","dplyr","stringr","R.utils","VGAM")
   
   # Install CRAN packages (if not already installed)
   .inst <- .packages %in% installed.packages()
   if(length(.packages[!.inst]) > 0) install.packages(.packages[!.inst])
   
    # Load packages into session 
   lapply(.packages, require, character.only=TRUE)
   
   savepath <- here::here("outputs","dirichelet_res", paste0(thispredstage, "_dirichelet"))
   dir.create(savepath)
   
   resultfile <-  paste0("diet_dirichelet_",thispredstage,".csv")
   pdafile <- paste0("Mode_pda_",thispredstage)
   datafile <- paste0("diet_composition_",thispredstage, ".csv")
   
    
   do_dirichelet(datafile, pdafile, resultfile, savepath, thispredstage)
   
 }
 
 stopCluster(cl)
```

```{r}
  dplyr::bind_rows()



```


Edit /outputs/ps_mean_diet_composition.csv to include new salmon functional groups and make it a tidy format

```{r}

func.groups <- here::here("data","PugetSoundAtlantisFunctionalGroupsV2.csv")
salmon.table <- here::here("data","res_salmon_table.csv")
diet.matrix <- here::here("outputs","ps_mean_diet_composition.csv")

tidy_diet_composition(diet.matrix, func.groups, salmon.table)
```

Compare new diet matrix with existing and update missing availability values in diet matrix, while keeping total diet proportions the same. This is done for each predator stage (adult, juvenile, invert) and the updated diet matrix is saved to a CSV file.

```{r}
pred.stages <- c("adult","juvenile","invert")
func.groups <- readr::read_csv(here::here("data","PugetSoundAtlantisFunctionalGroupsV2.csv"))
diet.matrix <- readr::read_csv(here::here("outputs","complete_diet_matrix.csv"))
biology.prm <- here::here("data","AMPSbioparam_mv1_2024_V10.prm")
dirichelet.path <- here::here("outputs","dirichelet_res")
revised.pprey <- here::here("outputs","revised_pprey.csv")

#add salmon resident groups to diet.matrix

pprey_maker(pred.stages, func.groups, diet.matrix, biology.prm, dirichelet.path, diet.matrix.file.name)

```
